paragraph: Taylor’s [fish in water](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#fish-water) **figures** the defining act remaining within its sustaining circumstance: stepping outside the element would end the activity meant to describe it. The [cage–window transformation](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#cage-window) **figures** the achieved change of use. A definite frame can disclose what it cannot contain, and faithful definition retains that frame while releasing enclosure. The whole’s [complete FT-P16](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#taylor-ft-p16) **figures** the speaking limit through the God-word’s changing contexts and the final release within saying; its polemical historical sequence retains a separate attribution task.

units.operation: Definition’s subject cannot stand outside its sustaining element.
Definition can enclose its referent or open a return to it.

paragraph: Taylor’s [Necker-cube movement](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#necker-cube) **figures** two operations which contextual transparency must distinguish. The visible lines remain while the depth-reading reverses; recognition can then hold the readings and their conditioned exchange within one account. This contextual holding does not add another face to the cube or an observer outside the event. The I–you–it exchange belongs within the field that lets each position appear, and returns through voiding exclusive possession into renewed participation.

units.operation: A view flips; context then holds views together without claiming one final reading.

paragraph: Taylor’s [complete kaleidoscope](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#kaleidoscope) **figures** a word becoming a local orbital centre while the patterned material constrains what its turn can disclose. Centring a term makes relations legible; decentring restores the whole that the term cannot exhaust. The mandala’s departure and return preserve this acquired orientation. [FT-P13](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#taylor-ft-p13) **figures** the corresponding pressure in speech: life leads the words which can transfix its flow, and their yielding lets articulation continue. The instrument’s non-arbitrary transformations, the poem’s verbal movement and Singh’s introductory witness retain their different offices; the cymatic and phonetic images supply no acoustic proof or etymology.

units.operation: A term becomes a local orbital centre and can be decentered; manifold interpretation is not arbitrary.

paragraph:
The [Taylor authored corpus](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#taylor-authored-images-whole) **figures** One and All through complete local movements whose endings return upon their initial determinations. [FT-P04](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#taylor-ft-p04) preserves the distinct One/All offices in its compressed reversal; [FT-P11](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#taylor-ft-p11) places signed cancellation beside the retained terms and four ordered pairings. [FT-P12](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#taylor-ft-p12) returns the limits of computing and thinking to their common root without becoming a computational impossibility theorem. [FT-P13](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#taylor-ft-p13) lets verbal fixation meet the life from which words arise. [FT-P14](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#taylor-ft-p14) retains productive contrast and its passage through love’s sixfold recollection; [FT-P15](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#taylor-ft-p15) answers severance by returning the cut to its genesis, horizon and sealed sides. Their different operations remain complementary. [FT-P16](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#taylor-ft-p16) carries the God-word and numerical account to a release within speaking, preserving the limit instead of turning the poem into a history of religions.

The [broken tessera](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#broken-symbolon-tessera) **figures** the two offices through the seam retained in each separated half. Absence, duration and the eventual encounter belong to its efficacy: the present half cannot certify its counterpart by declaring itself complete. The native sequence `/ = −/−`, `0/1`, `?/!`, `−/+`, `X/x`, `AM/IS`, `∞/dx`, `1/0` remains the derivational field of these refractions, with both full inverse parents, their `4+2` articulations and the coequal Name and Power offices intact.

units.operation: Poetic Two Ones and six routes retain their own wording and sequence; selected consumption follows local derivation.
Fracture retained as the means of recognition: separated halves authenticate their relation through reunion.

paragraph: Taylor’s [erased taijitu](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#erased-taijitu) **figures** the loss of each pole’s internal other while opposed outlines survive. Their sharpening does not restore the plurality erased inside them. Signed cancellation and directed appropriation therefore remain distinct failures of the relation, alongside the slash which retains it. The [Necker-cube sequence](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#necker-cube) **qualifies** the comparison by distinguishing successive reversal from contextual holding of the readings together: neither temporal office by itself determines whether the relation is retained. The erased dots are Taylor’s authored operation, not an attributed ancient taijitu doctrine.

units.operation: Two dots retain the living whole; one indicates orientation; none renders the dead binary. Monopoly erases its retained other.
A view flips; context then holds views together without claiming one final reading.

paragraph: The [Bohr taijitu emblem](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#bohr-taijitu-emblem) **compares** a bounded historical reception of complementarity with the native field already articulated here. Mutually exclusive experimental arrangements and selection within a given measurement retain different offices. The emblem can witness that reception without deriving the eight determinations, supplying Taylor’s erased-dot operation or assigning native `X/x` to a physicist. Its precise historical reproduction and motto retain their named source task; the authorially admitted comparison keeps its force within that boundary.

units.operation: A historical physics emblem participates as reception evidence, distinct from the author’s erased-dot operation.

paragraph: The [Bohr taijitu emblem](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#bohr-taijitu-emblem) **compares** the local regime’s criterion with the dependence of a determinate account on its arrangement of access. Selecting an outcome within an arrangement differs from recognising the relation between arrangements which cannot be exercised together. A local arbitration regime retains its discriminating competence when that dependence becomes available to review; it claims excessive jurisdiction when its criterion is made exhaustive of the field. This bounded authored comparison preserves the emblem’s historical provenance debt and does not turn complementarity into a clinical theory of complexes.

units.operation: A historical physics emblem participates as reception evidence, distinct from the author’s erased-dot operation.

paragraph: Taylor’s [Necker cube](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#necker-cube) **figures** a picture whose unchanged lines admit opposed readings, followed by contextual recognition of how those readings arise. The [centre-everywhere image](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#centre-everywhere) **extends** the atlas return through real nested internalities: each situated centre opens a world whose relations lead into further centres without acquiring a final exterior circumference. The atlas retains the transitions and the viewer’s place within them. It therefore cannot complete itself by installing a spectator outside all the worlds it makes traversable.

units.operation: Nested real internalities can each be a centre without a final objective circumference.
A view flips; context then holds views together without claiming one final reading.

paragraph: Taylor’s [broken symbolon and tessera](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#broken-symbolon-tessera) **figures** reliance across an interval which the present token cannot close by itself. Its fracture carries the absent counterpart through time, while recognition depends upon an encountered fit. The account can identify the seam and the conditions of matching; it cannot manufacture the other half’s arrival or the undertaking to answer. Trust continues through that finite relation with the possibility of failed recognition and renewed judgment intact. The material figure keeps its Greek institutional history as a distinct source task.

units.operation: Fracture retained as the means of recognition: separated halves authenticate their relation through reunion.

paragraph: Taylor’s [black sun and radiating star](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#black-sun-radiating-star) **figures** measure protecting its authority by first excluding interiority and then counting the resulting absence as evidence. The authored rings of philanthropy, capital, fixing and their compromising corona distribute dependence and the cost of exit. Cynicism consumes the capacity to answer, and blankness becomes available for reinscription under the same criterion. The star’s return releases capacity to question that measure; it does not demand transfer of allegiance to another centre. These are admitted authorial image operations, with no empirical allegation supplied by their personifications.

Taylor’s [God–city–bomb–surveillance–AI sequence](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#god-city-bomb-surveillance-ai) **figures** distinct ways a mediating apparatus can appropriate the source-office. Destruction removes a city’s shared conditions; surveillance can retain its buildings while capturing the persons who inhabit them; a fabricated image can present itself as originating witness. An entrusted office answers to these differences when the people and conditions it mediates can change its commission. The sequence’s historical telling and Giegerich relation remain separate source tasks, while the authored distinction between destruction, capture and counterfeit provenance is retained.

Taylor’s [centre-everywhere image](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#centre-everywhere) **figures** worldhood through real recursively nested internalities. A local world opens within relations which also appear from other centres, and a further reflection can enter those worlds without replacing their reality. This return preserves the real recursive Bimba relation: a produced reference map remains a reflection and does not acquire the originary office merely because it organises a later view. The image supplies no external spectator or final enclosing circumference, and its historical formula remains a distinct attribution task.

units.operation: Nested real internalities can each be a centre without a final objective circumference.

paragraph: Taylor’s [God-Other](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#god-other), [Shadow as other-self](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#shadow-other-self), [Friend as my-self’s-other](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#friend-myselfs-other) and [Alien/Enemy](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#alien-enemy) **figure** four different relations which the return must preserve. The source or archetypal totality exceeds a finite self-image; the disowned psychic other can transform that self’s organisation; the friend is an actual other centre whose response cannot be generated from my projection; the alien becomes an enemy when unfamiliarity is made to contain projected uncertainty. Recognising the last operation does not settle every judgment of danger. Psychic integration therefore leaves interpersonal refusal effective, and the constellation’s divine-mind and archetypal registers retain their distinction.

units.operation: Finite mind confronts source, law or archetypal totality; the divine-mind reading has its own register.
Disowned internal difference resists the ego’s completed self-model.
Another centre shares a world while exceeding one psyche’s production of it.
Denied uncertainty is projected into an externalised negative pole.

paragraph: Taylor’s [erased taijitu](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#erased-taijitu) **figures** divided participants whose internal plurality has been removed while the power of recombination is retained elsewhere. The [black sun–radiating star whole](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#black-sun-radiating-star) **extends** this accounting through private play’s protected decisions and public work’s visible performance. Its rings of philanthropy, capital, fixing and mutual compromise give the withheld return a differentiated body. The healthy Power–Play–Need–Sacrifice–Decision–Love–Work circulation remains coequal with Name–Truth–Mind–Word–Logos–Son–Image; release returns capacity and consequence to the commissioning relation. The [city–bomb–surveillance–AI sequence](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#god-city-bomb-surveillance-ai) **qualifies** this return by retaining destruction, capture within a continuing habitat and counterfeit source as different mechanisms. Their authored force does not certify a particular institution or technical case.

units.operation: Two dots retain the living whole; one indicates orientation; none renders the dead binary. Monopoly erases its retained other.
Adopt unit-social-power: energy captured versus circulated; Work/Play inversion and concentric attention rings retain their political operation.
Retain the cultural image’s change of medium and the distinct destruction/capture/counterfeit powers.

paragraph: Taylor’s [God–city–bomb–surveillance–AI sequence](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#god-city-bomb-surveillance-ai) **figures** a consequential image whose power changes the next encounter. A destroyed common habitat, a retained habitat whose persons are captured, and a fabricated originating witness change that field differently. The mirror’s initiating return must therefore disclose the source conditions and governing measure of its own image, so the addressed world can revise the next act. The authored sequence intensifies the three-motion vocation without claiming an implemented intervention or completing its historical telling.

units.operation: Retain the cultural image’s change of medium and the distinct destruction/capture/counterfeit powers.

paragraph: Taylor’s [cage and window](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#cage-window) **figure** the achieved form’s different uses. Both have a frame; the cage makes enclosure govern what can appear, while the window lets a definite aperture disclose beyond itself. A living symbol retains the determinate form through which encounter becomes possible and lets that encounter change its authority. The image’s return is the transformation of this relation, rather than an abolition of every frame or a guarantee that a deliberately fashioned symbol will become living.
